text.p: Lithuania's securities Commission said on Friday it decided to register the reorganisation of state-run Lithuanian Telecom and the Radio and Television centre as public companies.
"The commission registered the 814.91 million litas share capital of the Telecom," the head of the securities'registering department Aurelija Gasiuniene told Reuters.
She said the commission also registered the reorganisation into a public company of the Radio and Television transmission centre with share capital of 57.32 million litas.
The government has said the move was necessary to accelerate the privatisation process of the companies.
Both companies are 100 percent state run and they are on the government's list of companies to be privatised in 1997-1998.
The government was mulling the idea of merging the two companies before the privatisation process starts but a decision has not been taken.
The deadline to submit applications for the tender to become a lead advisor on the privatisation of Lithuanian Telecom expires on June 25.
